notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We made an update.

New features:
- Now it is possible to see your current score during adventure run & exit it anytime to return to the tavern. 

Balance tweaks:
- Field generation is adjusted to drop less empty cards.
- Skill points reset, appearance change & religion change is free of charge now! Yay!
- Rogue hero power cooldown is reduced.

Other changes:
- Added extra note to item enchant popup.
- Ultrawide screens support.
- Every enemy now has a name!
- Contract highlight improved.

Hope that you will like it!

Cheers,
icon.games team

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update is dedicated to balance tweaks for the first adventure (based on the community feedback).
The goal is to make game experience smoother & reduce grinding.

Hope that you will like it.

Cheers,
icon.games team

notes.title: V-Sync update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We just pushed an update with V-Sync enabled by default.
In the future update we will add possibility to turn on / off V-Sync from settings.

If anyone faces FPS issues - please let us know in comments.

Cheers,
icon.games team
